lock-n-load.name: Lock N' Load
lock-n-load.description: Reloading any weapon costs only 1 AP and dashing automatically reloads the active weapon.

repair-servos.name: Repair Servos
repair-servos.description: Repairs damage sustained in battle: When damaged, gain servos equal to 50% of the damage sustained. Each servo can heal 1 HP. At end of turn, use 20% of the servos available (minimum 1) and then lose 1 servo. Active servos are removed if this unit is fully healed or corroded.

platform-stability.name: Platform Stability
platform-stability.description: If this unit is on the ground and has not moved, they gain: +15 aim, -80% rocket scatter, and +1 damage to suppressive fire. Allows steadying of Autocannons, Vulcan Cannons, SAWs, and LMGs. Prevents damage from breaking a steadied weapon.

holo-rounds.name: Holo Rounds
holo-rounds.description: Firing at a target holos them for 3 turns [Prevents stealth, incoming shots gain +10 aim and +10 penetration].

shredder.name: Shredder
shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) for the remainder of the battle.

damage-control.name: Damage Control
damage-control.description: Grants +5% DR each time damage is received. If at full HP, grants +50 crit resist. If shredded, reduce shred to a maximum of 50% at end of turn.

reactive-targeting-sensors.name: Reactive Targeting Sensors
reactive-targeting-sensors.description: Once per enemy turn, if this unit is idle or on overwatch and is targeted by a standard attack (shot or melee): this unit gains +20% DR against that attack, returns fire with a +30 aim reaction shot, and then enters One For All (if able). [Basic reaction shots lower cover DR/def by half and cannot crit]

light-em-up.name: Light 'Em Up
light-em-up.description: Standard shots cost only 1 AP and gain both +5 penetration and +0.5 damage (rounded down) for each instance of damage their target took this turn.

close-combat-specialist.name: Close Combat Specialist
close-combat-specialist.description: Grants a reaction shot at any enemy within 4 tiles that acts. Reaction shot only activates on enemy's turn, once per enemy. [Basic reaction shots lower cover DR/def by half, cannot crit, and require hit chance >30]

critical-system-targeting.name: Critical System Targeting
critical-system-targeting.description: Shots against autopsied mechanical units deal +30% damage and gain +30 penetration (+60% damage and +60 penetration if steadied). Does not work with Arc Weapons.

fortified.name: Fortified
fortified.description: Grants immunity to critical hits. Injury and fatigue times are reduced by 15%.

absorption-fields.name: Absorption Fields
absorption-fields.description: Gain +5% DR. Shots from beam weapons (laser/pulse/drone/cyberdisc) lose their penetration when targeting this unit.

vital-point-targeting.name: Vital Point Targeting
vital-point-targeting.description: When hitting humans or autopsied biological aliens: steadied shots, reaction shots, or shots at targets not protected by cover deal 30% more damage.

bring-em-on.name: Bring 'Em On
bring-em-on.description: For each enemy in sight: this unit gains +0.5 damage on standard shots and incoming non-psionic attacks have a +5% graze chance.

smart-macrophages.name: Smart Macrophages
smart-macrophages.description: Grants complete immunity to corrosion and shredding.
